checks.notes: Rust 1.90.0 via RUSTC; PYTHONHASHSEED=1. Native LLVM/Clang/Rust comparisons through .ll and .bc, including integer, intrinsic, control-flow, memory, global, alias, constructor, indirect dispatch and aggregate ABI checks. Includes 31 symbol/store-span regressions, 23 startup/resource-boundary regressions and reproduction of all forty-seven bundled fonts/manifests. Aliased and quoted-name constructor startup use a native linked loader. Custom-layout memory is normalized under its original layout; host code generation is used only after memory/layout-dependent instructions and calls have been eliminated.

prior_checks.notes: Installed fontbuild/requirements.txt in the temporary environment, including Brotli for WOFF2 checks.

prior_checks_note: Retained from the earlier implementation validation; full Wasm/browser/fontbuild suites were not rerun for these frontend-only expansions.

review.scope: LLVM frontend, CLIs, generated examples/fonts/manifests, tests and documentation. Shared executable backend unchanged.
fixes: Read canonical 64-bit array lengths instead of the truncating llvmlite accessor, and check bounds before expansion.
Sort overflow flags so Python hash randomization cannot change font serialization.
Close LLVM modules and contexts in order on parsing and verification failures.
Distinguish quoted identifiers and string data from instruction modifiers, ABI attributes and callees.
Resolve lifetime roots iteratively and cache parsed source types.
Honor RUSTC consistently and ignore temporary CLI font/manifest outputs while retaining bundled assets.
Use canonical symbol keys for numbered and quoted global/function/alias identities across lookups, caches, dispatch and metadata.
Separate LLVM store spans from allocation/GEP stride, preserve global allocation padding, and exclude padding from scalar/pointer loads.
Parse section attributes outside quoted global names and initializer data so constructor tables cannot be silently skipped.
Reject unsupported Mach-O startup/finalizer type flags instead of ignoring initializer sections.
Bound source-file reads before parsing and check entry input-bit capacity during scalar/byval argument lowering.
